description: This file defines the ReportingMethodController class, which extends AbstractVueController to manage reporting method configurations within the OrangeHRM Pim plugin. It includes methods for retrieving reporting method data and preparing components for rendering.

classes.name: ReportingMethodController
classes.description: A controller class for handling reporting method configurations, extending AbstractVueController. It manages dependencies and prepares Vue components for UI rendering related to reporting methods.

methods.name: getReportingMethodService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ReportingMethodConfigurationService instance used by the controller.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and Vue component for rendering by setting up the reporting method list component with current in-use reporting method IDs.
